name: paraphrase_no_cue
note: Good call where the agent clearly restates the problem in their OWN words (no 'so you're saying' cue) and the customer confirms. Paraphrasing should pass; v2's cue-phrase-only check misses it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I'm really frustrated. My internet has been dropping every ten minutes for the last two days and I work from home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm really sorry to hear that, Maria, that sounds incredibly disruptive when you rely on it for work. I'll take ownership of this and get it sorted for you today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To protect your account, could you please confirm the PIN on the account and the billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, the PIN is 5521 and the address is 42 Main Street.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that all matches and you are verified now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your internet connection is cutting out roughly every ten minutes, and this has been going on for about two days while you work from home.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When the drops happen, does it affect every device at once, or just the computer you work on?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Every device, actually. Phone, TV, all of it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. Have you noticed if it happens more at a particular time of day?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Mostly in the evenings now that you mention it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I can see your line profile is on an older channel that gets congested in the evenings. I'm going to reset it to a cleaner channel now. One moment while I apply that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's done. Your line has re-synced on the new channel. Can you check if your connection looks stable now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Give me a second... yes, everything reconnected and it looks solid.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. So to confirm, the dropouts should be resolved now that you're on the new channel. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Maria?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and have a great rest of your day!
